mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction permits (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based weakening in demand, which triggers a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of active monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days as higher borrowing costs dampen corporate investment and consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 110.0, it signals strong economic output that boosts corporate profits, causing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 110.0, or the Rank IC over 2 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When consumer spending (RSAFS) exceeds 370,000 million dollars, it indicates strong household demand that supports corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS > 370000, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%) and rising job growth (PAYEMS > 150,000), the labor market is overheating, which triggers inflationary pressures and central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS > 150000, or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to maintain restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
